{'translation': 'Last week, Sonos announced a series of new features coming to its app, and the first of these upgrades has officially launched with the "Sonos 27" app update. Here are the details.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': '以下是 Sonos 公佈嘅 Sonos 27 軟件新功能同即將推出嘅項目', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'Following the approach taken with iOS 27 and other platforms, Sonos has renamed its software platform to "Sonos 27".', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'Sonos 27 officially launched today through a new app update on the App Store. Wondering whether your hardware is compatible? Sonos says it supports "all Sonos S2 products", though support for individual features may vary by product.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'Here are the features Sonos announced as available immediately:', 'notes': ''}

  • {'translation': 'Portable Surround Sound: "Two identical Sonos portable speakers (Move 2 or Sonos Play) can be paired as rear surround speakers compatible with a soundbar, and will automatically revert to their original role when moved, allowing existing hardware to do more without the need for a separate home theatre setup."', 'notes': ''}
  • {'translation': '全新 Sonos 27 應用程式導航：「重新設計嘅應用程式，導航更簡單，備有滑動手勢同已釘選房間，方便用戶更快速操控。」', 'notes': ''}
  • {'translation': '耳機連線（早期測試）：「Ace Ultra 耳機可以連接到 Sonos 系統，等用戶唔使透過手機，就可以將聲音喺附近嘅喇叭同耳機之間推送。」', 'notes': ''}
  • {'translation': 'Sonos 27 mcp（早期測試）：「將 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 助手連接到 Sonos，等用戶有多一個選擇，而唔係被綁死喺單一助手身上。」', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'Sonos 同時預告咗兩項即將推出嘅功能：', 'notes': ''}

  • {'translation': 'Sonos 27 voice（今年秋季稍後推出）：「Sonos 自家以音樂為核心嘅助理，強調冇任何單一 AI 需要主宰家居，並以消費者嘅選擇為本去設計。」', 'notes': ''}
  • {'translation': 'Sonos 自訂代理（2027年）：「畀用戶喺系統內自行建立代理，每個代理可以擁有唔同嘅設定、人格同聲音。」', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': "A few years ago, Sonos's major app redesign caused quite a stir. This time, the navigation update is clearly much smaller in scope, so hopefully it won't spark another controversy.", 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'What do you think of the changes to the Sonos 27 app? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.', 'notes': ''}
